verdict.rationale: Mesh exposes a broad documented API covering most of the core workflow: customer screening (sync, async and batch), monitoring configuration, case audit trails, exports, roles, transaction processing and webhooks. A published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema covers customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources, and the docs say cases, alerts and risks can be remediated either in the web app or via the API. However, the docs never claim full UI–API parity. API credentials are generated in the web application, and there is no evidence that risk-score equation or screening-configuration setup can be done via the API. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API-based credential and access management, API endpoints for risk-scoring and screening-configuration setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
